baseline_models.focus_anchor: The owned garden, its palms and grapes, the second-person causative, plural rivers, interior traversal, and emphatic cognate accusative form one system.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tree-screened mixed orchard depends on water forced into multiple channels; wide openings carry flow through its intervals, converting possessed land into an actively irrigated domain.

activation_trace.role: The tree-screened garden supplies the bounded cultivated domain.
Palms supply one durable crop layer of the mixed orchard.
Grapes supply the second cultivated crop and make irrigation functionally necessary.
Wide splitting and water release provide the activating action, intensified by its repeated verbal noun.
Flowing rivers supply a plural channel network that cuts through land.
Intervals between things route the channels throughout the garden interior.

changed_reading.after: An owned mixed orchard demonstrated as a fully activated irrigation network whose channels are made to penetrate its interior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The semantic movement runs from a screened garden to splitting, widening, and flow through its gaps.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden first encloses and hides with dense growth; rupture then opens routes through that enclosure, so moving water renders the interior legible from within rather than merely decorating it.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the screened starting state of the garden.
A wide breach changes enclosure into an opened and emitting interior.
Opening and widening until flow supplies perceptible routes through the enclosure.
The gaps specify that disclosure occurs across the garden's internal spaces.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a closed scene of abundance.
changed_reading.after: The scene stages a screened interior becoming manifest through ruptures and distributed flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding demand asks for one spring to erupt from the earth for the speakers; 17:91 upgrades it to an estate for the addressee with two crop classes and multiple rivers under intensified second-person causation. Access to water becomes proof of domain-scale control.

activation_trace.role: The cultivated enclosure turns a water event into a whole productive estate.
Repeated wide bursting supplies controlled release at the expanded scale.
Plural land-cutting rivers replace the prior single source.
The first water-bursting demand supplies the immediate lower-scale precursor.
Earth supplies the substrate from which the initial proof must emerge.
A spring's upwelling supplies the singular source that 17:91 expands into a network.

structural_cues: 17:90 immediately precedes 17:91, and singular ينبوعا becomes plural الأنهار.
The beneficiary shifts from لنا to proprietary لك, while 17:91 doubles the bursting root in verb and cognate accusative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spring, an owned mixed orchard, plural rivers, and intensified causation; I infer escalation in scale and required control. A simple list of equivalent water miracles remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah requests one more watery fertility miracle.
changed_reading.after: It is an escalated specification: not one usable source for the crowd, but proof that the addressee commands an entire self-watering productive domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window first joins dawn, recitation, and witnessing, then describes the Quran as sent down for healing; after the hydraulic demands it specifies another acceptable descent as a book the speakers can read. The focus water-burst becomes a materialized substitute for an already witnessed and beneficial disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Hydraulic splitting anchors the demanded material manifestation.
Recitation supplies the verbal medium already present at the window's opening.
Daybreak supplies a non-hydraulic opening on the same mapped root as the focus rupture.
Presence with witnessing marks that dawn recitation as already publicly attended.
Sending down supplies revelation's directional arrival before the demanded spectacles.
Healing supplies the benefit already attributed to the descending Quran.
An explicitly written object supplies the crowd's later replacement criterion.
Their demanded reading loops back to the recitational medium they already had.

structural_cues: 17:78 has قرآن الفجر twice and closes it with مشهودا; the same ف ج ر root becomes hydrological in 17:90-91.
17:82 sends down Quranic healing, whereas 17:93 conditions belief on a book sent down علينا that they themselves read.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated recitation, descent, benefit, witnessing, and the dawn/water root shift; I infer that the hydraulic proof externalizes revelation into coercively tangible benefit. The water request may instead be unrelated miracle imagery.

changed_reading.before: Bursting rivers visibly certify agricultural abundance.
changed_reading.after: The hydraulic eruption also figures a demanded conversion of received recitation into a physically inspectable, crowd-specified disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is presented as something God can remove, with no agent available against Him; the later answer identifies the addressee only as a human messenger, and the next ayah says guidance was blocked precisely by that human medium. The focus demand instead assigns him proprietary and causative disposal.

activation_trace.role: The garden's required concrete occurrence anchors the test imposed on the addressee.
Second-person causation makes personal command of the water the operative criterion.
Divine revelation supplies the gift whose retention is outside the messenger's control.
An agent sufficient to manage an affair supplies the explicitly unavailable control role.
The visibly human creature supplies the response's limiting category.
Messenger and message define transmission, not sovereign production, as his office.
Guidance already arriving by gentle direction sharpens the mismatch with forced spectacle.

structural_cues: 17:86 says no لك ... علينا وكيلا; 17:91 demands a garden لك and that you personally burst its rivers.
17:93 answers the whole list with هل كنت إلا بشرا رسولا, and 17:94 names a human messenger as the obstacle claimed against arrived guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast between removable revelation, unavailable control, demanded causation, and human messengership; I infer that the test misassigns divine disposal to the messenger. They could simply be asking God to act through him.

changed_reading.before: The crowd asks the messenger to authenticate himself with an extraordinary asset.
changed_reading.after: The demand is a category error: it will accept transmission only if the human messenger performs as proprietor and disposer of divine-scale processes.

context_deltas.mechanism: After every kind of example has been deployed and refused, the focus orchard sits inside a chain of alternatives that continues through falling sky, ascent, and a readable book; even ascent receives a further condition. The garden is therefore a provisional threshold in a recursively extendable test.

activation_trace.role: The garden supplies the bounded miracle item whose apparent sufficiency is revised by the sequence.
The deployed example supplies the already diversified evidentiary field.
Refusal supplies the response to that prior diversity of evidence.
Blocking truth supplies the disposition immediately before the speakers set new conditions.
Detached pieces of sky extend the alternatives beyond terrestrial productivity.
Ascent supplies an apparently maximal feat that still fails to close the test.
Heart-settling assent is explicitly withheld even from the ascent itself.
The written object supplies the next condition nested inside the ascent condition.

structural_cues: The focus begins with أو and is followed by more أو alternatives in 17:92-93.
17:93 contains ولن نؤمن لرقيك حتى, nesting another threshold after the requested ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior refusal, serial alternatives, and an explicit condition nested after ascent; I infer non-finality rather than a stable evidentiary contract. A sincere cumulative specification remains grammatically possible.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a discrete miracle which, if supplied, would settle belief.
changed_reading.after: It is one movable checkpoint in an open-ended refusal structure whose next condition is already waiting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Quran challenge invokes hidden beings, refusal is then expressed through a covering root, and the demand selects a tree-screened garden. The concealment cluster allows the requested spectacle to function not only as disclosure but as another screen placed over the sign already present.

activation_trace.role: The garden's own concealment potential anchors the screen image in the focus.
Hidden beings activate the same mapped root immediately before the refusal and demand sequence.
Covering truth supplies the rhetorical function that the newly requested spectacle may continue.

structural_cues: 17:88 has الجن, 17:89 ends with كفورا, and 17:91 asks for جنة.
The requested screened garden follows, rather than precedes, the statement that every kind of example has been refused.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the concealment branches and tight sequence; I infer a rhetorical feedback loop, not a claim that جنة lexically means disbelief. The ordinary garden and ordinary refusal readings remain primary.

changed_reading.before: A spectacular garden would remove concealment by making proof visible.
changed_reading.after: The lush proof can itself become a covering layer that postpones engagement with the sign already given.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand seeks an opened, inspectable interior as credential before human observers, but the sequence closes by declaring God sufficient as witness, inwardly informed and seeing. The direction of inspection reverses: the people are not ultimate judges of the sign but objects of comprehensive witness.

activation_trace.role: A screened garden supplies the interior that the demanded river display would expose.
Opening until flow supplies the inspectable manifestation demanded from the messenger.
Declared sufficiency closes the demand for additional humanly specified proof.
Presence with witnessing relocates the decisive observer from the crowd to God.
Knowledge of inward reality makes the speakers' disposition part of what is inspected.
Seeing supplies the final visual capacity and reverses the direction of proof-testing.

structural_cues: The alternatives of 17:90-95 end in 17:96 with كفى بالله شهيدا.
17:96 moves from witness between the parties to God's inward knowledge and sight of His servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demanded visual display and a closing sufficient witness who knows and sees; I infer a reversal in the observer-observed relation. The close may function only as general attestation of the message.

changed_reading.before: The garden must open itself to satisfy the crowd's inspection.
changed_reading.after: The demand belongs to a contested witness economy that the close reverses: the would-be inspectors are themselves fully witnessed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because water and rivers are the dominant surface senses, but both focus roots directly carry dawn/daylight branches and remain anchored to the screened garden. Render only as a secondary light resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence can be heard as concealment followed by daybreak and the widening of day through internal gaps.

activation_trace.role: Screening supplies the darkness-like interior from which the light resonance begins.
Daybreak from night supplies sudden illumination as a secondary image of bursting.
Daylight opening supplies the widened luminous field following daybreak.

changed_reading.before: Water channels open through a shaded orchard.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, dawn widens into day through the screened garden while the literal rivers remain primary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because ملائكة is ordinarily resolved by the angel branch, while the sovereignty branch is only an activation. The estate, commanding water, gold house, ascent, and angel sequence still supports it; render as a portfolio-level resonance, not as a lexical claim that angels means kingship here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proprietary لك, productive estate, and personally commanded rivers can function as the first assets in a demanded sovereign portfolio.

activation_trace.role: The garden supplies landed productive property at the center of the portfolio.
Capacity and jurisdiction supply the nearby legitimate authority frame.
The non-dominant sovereignty branch activates royal scale behind the requested angelic attendance.
A dwelling supplies the palace-like built asset added after the garden.
Gold supplies conspicuous wealth and converts the dwelling into status display.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an isolated fertility miracle.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sequence-level activation, it is the landed first component of a crowd-designed kingship imposed on a messenger.

strongest_changes: 17:90-91 scales one spring for us into an owned mixed estate with multiple forcibly opened rivers.
The ف ج ر shift from witnessed dawn recitation to hydraulic rupture makes the garden a materialized substitute for received disclosure.
17:86 and 17:93-94 expose the demand's agency mismatch, while 17:96 reverses who finally inspects whom.
summary.what_was_special: The focus joins enclosure, rupture, plural channels, and interstitial flow in one compact mechanism; context turns that physical system into a test of control, acceptable media, and authority rather than a generic image of abundance.
remaining_uncertainties: The dawn-water ف ج ر resonance may be contextual wordplay or only root recurrence.
The concealment cluster across الجن, كفورا, and جنة is traceable but rhetorically speculative.
The serial conditions strongly suggest non-finality, though they can still be read as a sincere cumulative list.
